content.markdown: The base containing the fields common to all three branches of the `SnlSyntaxTree` union: `macro_name` (a macro name or delimiter payload), `kind` (`bvar`, `fvar`, `binder`, `rule`, and so on, or empty), `children` (an array of child nodes), `mdata` (a free-form metadata bag), `style_name` (an optional style-variant name), and `scope` (a structural scope marker).
